listing.name: Doom 3 (classic) (dhewm3)
listing.summary: Use the official dhewm3 Windows player with your own classic Doom 3 files. Prepare originals separately and keep the external save profile backed up.

steps.title: Keep an existing prepared copy
steps.instruction: For a separately prepared copy, read originals from another installation using three separate argument lines: +set, fs_basepath, then the absolute folder containing base and any d3xp data. This custom option retains the external route and does not make Portcove manage or migrate its originals, saves or runtime.

warnings: Back up that external profile and your original game separately before changing engines or versions.

references.title: Prepare the upstream Linux player
references.instruction: Choose the official dhewm3 amd64 or arm64 game tarball. Extract the complete folder and keep its game libraries. Place your classic Doom 3 v1.3.1 base/pak000.pk4 through base/pak008.pk4 in matching folders. Start ./dhewm3 from the prepared directory. Preserve ~/.config/dhewm3 and ~/.local/share/dhewm3 or their XDG equivalents, plus any custom paths. Install SDL2, OpenAL and libcurl through your distribution. The inspected ARM64 executable needs glibc 2.38.

references.title: Set up dhewm3 on Mac
references.instruction: Use the universal Mac Source Ports build linked from dhewm3.org. Copy dhewm3.app out of its disk image. Put your classic Doom 3 v1.3.1 base/pak000.pk4 through base/pak008.pk4 in matching folders under ~/Library/Application Support/dhewm3. Open the app directly. Preserve that profile, its saves, and all original-data locations.

data_locations: saves, settings, screenshots, demos and logs in actual Documents/My Games/dhewm3 with separate base and d3xp scopes
original game installation and any custom external profile

preparation.title: Prepare your original game
preparation.instruction: Before Play, copy only base/pak000.pk4 through base/pak008.pk4 from your own classic Doom 3 installation patched to 1.3.1 into the matching base folder beside dhewm3.exe. Keep the original installation separately. BFG Edition is a different product; do not copy its files or old engine executables/DLLs over this runtime. Prepare these files yourself and check the edition against the upstream instructions; Portcove does not verify their original-game identity. The official Windows player is 32-bit and runs on 64-bit Windows through Windows compatibility support. Keep the package's own DLLs and resources together. Its optional mods and widescreen-GUI downloads are separate; customized runtime or mod layouts can keep an external registration.

warnings: Use a short library path containing plain ASCII characters for this Windows build. Its external profile locations have their own upstream path limits. Older installations retain their original path contract.
Use the existing non-owning route for custom fs_basepath/fs_savepath/fs_configpath, custom mods, the separate dedicated server or another upstream workflow.
